title: The Master Healer's Soul Companion
summary: A companion for healers past the courses that adds the deep restoring mend and the recall of a soul slipping from the body.

title: A Treatise on Binding the Broken Soul
summary: A treatise on setting fractures of the soul and reassembling a soul that a heavy blow has shattered into pieces.

title: The Canon of the Deep Cleansing
summary: A canon on purging erosion and curse from the soul and on easing the backlash of a failed breakthrough.

title: The Twin Hand Treatise
summary: A treatise on healing with two matched hands of soul force so that each hand steadies the work of the other.

title: The Azure Hawk Mender's Course
summary: A course in the sharp-eyed healing of the hawk school that finds the wound from above and lifts a fallen soul skyward.

title: The Basin and River Remedy
summary: A remedy book that lets healing gather in a basin of the soul and run out along a river of force to where it is needed.

title: Wind-Sworn Soul Care
summary: A book of care for the soul as the wind-sworn practise it with an open hand and an oath never to turn a patient away.

title: The Open Sky Mender's Oath
summary: A mender's oath-book that teaches healing in the open air with a steady bearing and no shelter but the healer's own force.

title: The Tireless Hand Oath-Book
summary: An oath-book for the healer who keeps working through a long night and teaches how to give force without running dry.
